notes.title: ASTEROID FIGHT is leaving Early Access - 1.0 is coming on April 10th
notes.content:
Good news everybody! ASTEROID FIGHT is released to 1.0 on April 10th!
Early Access helped us a lot with identifying bugs, building requested features, letting the community decide on which new items should be implemented, growing a small community, optimizing infrastructure, holding tournaments and playing lots of matches. Thank you all for your support!

1.0 is finally bringing a lot of features and changes since we originally started into Early Access:

 ASTEROID FIGHT will be released as Free to Play! Multiplayer games live from participation and therefore we wanted to lower the bar for new players to get involved. To cover the server costs we are introducing an ingame upgrade shop for convenience features. Convenience features can be purchased with REFINED MINERALS + COSA (COins rewarded for Special Activities). REFINED MINERALS can be purchased with real money or COSA. COSA can be earned through different activities like winning or losing ranked matches. We wanted to reward participation, so you don't need to spend real money to get the convinience features - with COSA you can earn them through playing as well. All players already owning ASTEROID FIGHT will get enough INVENTORY SLOTS for their arsenal as well as PRESET SLOTS. 
 performance improvements
 better match making, so ASTEROID FIGHT is ready for a bigger amount of players
 UI improvements
 player skins
 new special abilities
 an exclusive ingame soundtrack made by Matteo Schiavinato


To celebrate the upcoming release, we are doing a special offer starting today!

 We are giving a discount of 90% on ASTEROID FIGHT! Starting right now, ASTEROID FIGHT will be available for only 1,19$!
 All new players purchasing the game before the switch to F2P will get REFINED MINERALS worth 4$!

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS NOW!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/ff424967b349afccb94bd2f520e38b7971dd6eaa.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/9823e6b32b876d83aa1584d6d52ac13b90e65269.png
In celebration of the launch, a special time-limited dark skin for the Scout will be available in-game! This hull skin will only be available during the first week - so make sure to grab it before it’s too late!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/f1ea3591f2d4ac1585c671526be705fe95ed8567.png
With the EA release today we are moving to version 0.9.28. These are the news and updates we want to share with you alongside this important step for ASTEROID FIGHT:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/681ac94bcfbb0ab39ee0393b46782c1bbb02cabe.png
Servers are up and running! Servers in the USA, Europe, Asia and Russia are ready for you!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/29790e86afb155827a3f8e74feed37b80dd7b010.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/1397485a6ba713871894005a2d2c7d679bbc4b4e.png
Every map demands another strategy and has a unique emphasis on one of the game mechanics:

The ARENA3 lanes, 3 energy nodes. The center of the map is a constantly contested spot. This is the classic map with lots of asteroids and strategic possibilities. Thin passages from the center to the outer regions only let through small units.
The CANYONOne lane, where you build up pressure while you’re pushing the front more and more to your opponent! The map reminds of tower defense. Warp highly recommended! :)
The CHAMBERS4 x 4 + 1 center chamber = 17 chambers that you can occupy. The master of the chambers will dominate the map! Tic Tac Toe with asteroids!
The VESTIBULEFast-paced, open map for in between matches. Don’t blink or you might lose this one! ;)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/2c5d4205149e2a8085efa522ad9951e78798dcf6.png
Assemble your commander with the unique items earned from previous battles! Here you can save presets. When entering a ranked match, you can chose between your presets so you can fight with the most suitable commander in terms of team composition and map!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/96d7505d7e62097f12d39f0a09b4e325b0f3c378.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/599cc00dc5ff52b5138d2afc940c5888f187c8fd.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/e674565ac74c1cf41e6db24a8c223abf9ba24cdb.png
Every ship hull comes with different attributes:

The SCOUTMedium agile and medium strong commander. Good allrounder!
The EXPLORERVery fast and agile - but weak - ship!
The HEAVYSlow, but strong unit with additional energy!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/aa4bed429002170ecc089996501359d7d2ea0bb7.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/bbfdfc3aa013bc0a4429e27087cc980964e15e4a.png

CloakMake yourself invisible for a limited amount of time.
EMPThe EMP stuns units in its range.
Homing MissileStrong, controllable missile.
Proximity MineThe proximity mine will detect and explode (with a short delay) when enemies come into the detection range.
RailgunHighly energized rail beam that damages all units in the beam.
Repair DroidRepairs your ship on activation.
Time BenderBends the time so affected entities in the effect radius will experience a distorted time. Depending on the item values, the time bender will slow down or speed up the time.
Utility FogSmall nanobots that repair your ship and ships in your surrounding.
WarpInstant warp the hero to another position.
Zelos RaysImproves worker efficiency by +20% (lvl0) in your surrounding.
ModModifies different values of your ship. 
Plasma CannonHighly energized particles to heat up your enemies.
RocketsSix deadly rockets are launched per batch.
… a lot more to come during EA!!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/e9d9cdf15581be3d70d37793350caed3fc2cf36d.png
Play custom online matches with or against bots and your friends! You can even turn on and off various game mechanics like communication power, DMG boost, creeps or even the presence of commander ships at all so you can turn the game into a traditional RTS game! :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/36da5685640a50666b833d439e8d9c4be503eba3.png
Watch other players play a match in TV mode or control where you want to focus your attention on your own! Perfect for streamers! ;)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/66f1d3591004db5d61200c2b6889634516976a00.png
One major goal during Early Access is to get lots of new features, items, maps & play modes into the game! It`s very important to us to get the community involved in the process. As a first step into EA we want to know what you want us to bring into the game next! The voting will take place on http://discord.asteroidfight.com. It is up to you to choose an item out of these five:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/0693f49b659bced82b21e265c74ac27a006930cd.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/db732b3d27641b1ecf7a9552037840f0d4c501ab.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/606fff9f799dd589646cb3e87b70974b8ee28178.png

We (Klaus & Peter from Katta Games) do hope you enjoy Asteroid Fight as much as we do! See you in-game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/ebc283837edd1915838f07da29ff0969c444146d.png

notes.title: EA release: September 28th!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/31d048a629d6d06d2722aa65806d5e154fa1477c.jpg

Hello Everyone!

Today we're thrilled to announce our Early Access launch date!

Thanks everyone for your support, the feedback and participation via twitter, facebook, discord and at the beta test-events!

Asteroid Fight will be available on September 28th! Save the date!

We are looking forward to some awesome new items, maps & features during early access, and are eager to share it with you!

See you All ingame on September 28th!

notes.title: June 2017 - a short update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27449870/bab662254f705d51c09f1dff1919b5401422cc07.jpgIn the midst of the summer heat, things are going well for Asteroid Fight! A lot has changed! Network, physics, graphics, maps, usability, functionality,... everything is progressing. In fact, we worked so hard on the game that we hadn’t found any time for writing announcements. ;) 
 
We are already organizing weekly test games and are in the middle of making the game capable of handling bigger numbers of players. If you want to join the pool of testers for this weekly event write us an email -> office@asteroidfight.com
